arxiv-1910-08057.title: Graph Embedding VAE: A Permutation Invariant Model of Graph Structure Thanks: Work done as an intern at AITRICS.
arxiv-1910-08057.creator: Tony Duan, Juho Lee
arxiv-1910-08057.description: Abstract Generative models of graph structure have applications in biology and social sciences. The state of the art is GraphRNN, which decomposes the graph generation process into a series of sequential steps. While effective for modest sizes, it loses its permutation invariance for larger graphs.

arxiv-2105-02427.title: Resilient Time-Varying Output Formation Tracking of Linear Multi-Agent Systems Against Unbounded FDI Sensor Attacks and Unreliable Digraphs
arxiv-2105-02427.creator: Zhi Feng, Guoqiang Hu
arxiv-2105-02427.description: Abstract One salient feature of cooperative formation tracking is its distributed nature that relies on localized control and information sharing over a sparse communication network. That is, a distributed control manner could be prone to malicious attacks and unreliable communication that deteriorate the formation tracking performance or even destabilize the whole multi-agent system.

arxiv-2301-07826.title: Quadratic-soliton-enhanced mid-IR molecular sensing
arxiv-2301-07826.creator: Robert M. Gray, Mingchen Liu, Selina Zhou, Arkadev Roy, Luis Ledezma, Alireza Marandi
arxiv-2301-07826.description: Abstract Optical solitons have long been of interest both from a fundamental perspective and because of their application potential. Both cubic (Kerr) and quadratic nonlinearities can lead to soliton formation, but quadratic solitons can practically benefit from stronger nonlinearity and achieve substantial wavelength conversion.

arxiv-2303-16462.title: Effect of Coriolis force on the shear viscosity of quark matter: A nonrelativistic description
arxiv-2303-16462.creator: Cho Win Aung 1 , Ashutosh Dwibedi 1 , Jayanta Dey 2 Sabyasachi Ghosh 1
arxiv-2303-16462.description: Abstract Shear viscosity becomes anisotropic in a rotating medium. It is discovered here that for rotating thermalized quantum systems such as those created in relativistic heavy ion collisions, the coefficient of shear viscosity breaks up into five independent components. Similar phenomena were also discovered for quark-gluon plasma in the presence of the magnetic field.

arxiv-2307-03323.title: Machine Learning to detect cyber-attacks and discriminating the types of power system disturbances Conference: ; 25; 2023 Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2307-03323.creator: Diane Tuyizere, Remy Ihabwikuzo
arxiv-2307-03323.description: Abstract . This research proposes a machine learning-based attack detection model for power systems, specifically targeting smart grids. By utilizing data and logs collected from Phasor Measuring Devices (PMUs), the model aims to learn system behaviors and effectively identify potential security boundaries. The proposed approach involves crucial stages including dataset pre-processing, feature selection, model creation, and evaluation.

arxiv-2309-02223.title: The worst-case complexity of symmetric strategy improvement
arxiv-2309-02223.creator: Tom van Dijk, Georg Loho, Matthew T. Maat
arxiv-2309-02223.description: Abstract Symmetric strategy improvement is an algorithm introduced by Schewe et al. (ICALP 2015) that can be used to solve two-player games on directed graphs such as parity games and mean payoff games. In contrast to the usual well-known strategy improvement algorithm, it iterates over strategies of both players simultaneously.

arxiv-2412-01100.title: The Codec Language Model-based Zero-Shot Spontaneous Style TTS System for CoVoC Challenge 2024
arxiv-2412-01100.description: Abstract This paper describes the zero-shot spontaneous style TTS system for the ISCSLP 2024 Conversational Voice Clone Challenge (CoVoC). We propose a LLaMA-based codec language model with a delay pattern to achieve spontaneous style voice cloning. To improve speech intelligibility, we introduce the Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) strategy in the language model to strengthen conditional guidance on token prediction.

arxiv-2503-14246.title: Trading-off Accuracy and Communication Cost in Federated Learning
arxiv-2503-14246.creator: Mattia Jacopo Villani, Emanuele Natale, Frederik Mallmann-Trenn
arxiv-2503-14246.description: Abstract . Leveraging the training-by-pruning paradigm introduced by Zhou et al. [NeurIPS’19], Isik et al. [ICLR’23] introduced a federated learning protocol that achieves a 34-fold reduction in communication cost. We achieve a compression improvements of orders of orders of magnitude over the state-of-the-art.

arxiv-2505-19470.title: Information-theoretic Generalization Analysis for VQ-VAEs: A Role of Latent Variables
arxiv-2505-19470.creator: Futoshi FutamiThe University of Osaka / RIKEN AIP futami.futoshi.es@osaka-u.ac.jp Masahiro FujisawaThe University of Osaka / RIKEN AIP fujisawa@ist.osaka-u.ac.jp
arxiv-2505-19470.description: Abstract Latent variables (LVs) play a crucial role in encoder–decoder models by enabling effective data compression, prediction, and generation. Although their theoretical properties, such as generalization, have been extensively studied in supervised learning, similar analyses for unsupervised models such as variational autoencoders (VAEs) remain insufficiently underexplored.

arxiv-2509-04465.title: Emotionally-Aware Agents for Dispute Resolution
arxiv-2509-04465.creator: Sushrita Rakshit, James Hale, Kushal Chawla, Jeanne M. Brett, Jonathan Gratch
arxiv-2509-04465.description: Abstract In conflict, people use emotional expressions to shape their counterparts’ thoughts, feelings, and actions. This paper explores whether automatic text emotion recognition offers insight into this influence in the context of dispute resolution. Prior work has shown the promise of such methods in negotiations; however, disputes evoke stronger emotions and different social processes.

arxiv-2510-20285.title: DMC 3 : Dual-Modal Counterfactual Contrastive Construction for Egocentric Video Question Answering Conference: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 27–31, 2025; Dublin, Ireland. Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’25), Octobe
arxiv-2510-20285.creator: Jiayi Zou, Chaofan Chen, Bing-Kun Bao, Changsheng Xu
arxiv-2510-20285.description: Abstract . Egocentric Video Question Answering (Egocentric VideoQA) plays an important role in egocentric video understanding, which refers to answering questions based on first-person videos. Although existing methods have made progress through the paradigm of pre-training and fine-tuning, they ignore the unique challenges posed by the first-person perspective, such as understanding multiple events and recognizing hand-object interactions.

pmc-10537635.title: Towards Low-Temperature CVD Synthesis and Characterization of Mono- or Few-Layer Molybdenum Disulfide
pmc-10537635.creator: Sachin Shendokar, Frederick Aryeetey, Moha Feroz Hossen, Tetyana Ignatova, Shyam Aravamudhan
pmc-10537635.description: Molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) transistors are a promising alternative for the semiconductor industry due to their large on/off current ratio (>1010), immunity to short-channel effects, and unique switching characteristics. MoS2 has drawn considerable interest due to its intriguing electrical, optical, sensing, and catalytic properties. Monolayer MoS2 is a semiconducting material with a direct band gap of ~1.

pmc-10726424.title: MicroRNA-451a inhibits gemcitabine-refractory biliary tract cancer progression by suppressing the MIF-mediated PI3K/AKT pathway
pmc-10726424.creator: Taisuke Obata, Koichiro Tsutsumi, Eijiro Ueta, Takashi Oda, Tatsuya Kikuchi, Soichiro Ako, Yuki Fujii, Tatsuhiro Yamazaki, Daisuke Uchida, Kazuyuki Matsumoto, Shigeru Horiguchi, Hironari Kato, Hiroyuki Okada, Motoyuki Otsuka
pmc-10726424.description: Gemcitabine is an effective chemotherapeutic agent for biliary tract cancers (BTCs), including gallbladder cancer (GBC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CCA). However, few other effective agents are currently available, particularly for GEM-refractory BTCs. We previously identified microRNA-451a (miR-451a) as a potential therapeutic target in GBC.

pmc-11505378.title: Employing Titanium Dioxide Nanoparticles as Biostimulant against Salinity: Improving Antioxidative Defense and Reactive Oxygen Species Balancing in Eggplant Seedlings
pmc-11505378.creator: Muhammad Fasih Khalid, Muhammad Zaid Jawaid, Muddasir Nawaz, Rana Abdul Shakoor, Talaat Ahmed
pmc-11505378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Salinity is a major abiotic stress that affects the agricultural sector and poses a significant threat to sustainable crop production. Nanoparticles (NPs) act as biostimulants and significantly mitigate abiotic stress. In this context, this experiment was designed to assess the effects of foliar application of titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles at 200 and 400 ppm on the growth of eggplant (Solanum melongena) seedlings under moderate (75 mM) and high (150 mM) salinity stress.

pmc-11618737.title: Nonclassical Spin‐Multiplexing Metasurfaces Enabled Multifunctional Meta‐Scope
pmc-11618737.creator: Chuang Sun, Zixuan Wang, Kian Shen Kiang, Oleksandr Buchnev, Dawei Tang, Jize Yan, Jun‐Yu Ou
pmc-11618737.description: Dielectric metasurfaces have emerged as attractive devices for advanced imaging systems because of their high efficiency, ability of wavefront manipulation, and lightweight. The classical spin‐multiplexing metasurfaces can only provide two orthogonal circular polarization channels and require high phase contrast which limits their applications.

pmc-11625052.title: A randomized phase 1 study of safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of MK-1088, a novel dual adenosine receptor antagonist, in healthy adult participants
pmc-11625052.creator: Pranav Gupta, Manash Chatterjee, Yeonil Kim, Kathleen Deschamps, Lieselotte Lemoine, Kristien Van Dyck, Catherine Zhou Matthews, Sylvie Rottey, Aubrey Stoch, Eseng Lai
pmc-11625052.description: This phase 1 first-in-human study evaluated the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of MK-1088, a novel, small-molecule dual inhibitor of adenosine A2A and A2B receptors. Healthy adult participants were enrolled in two panels (n = 8 each) and randomly assigned to receive MK-1088 (n = 6) or placebo (n = 2) orally in each of five treatment periods.

pmc-12566428.title: Bioactive Potential of Protein Extracts Derived from Dried Wolffia globosa on In Vitro Antioxidant Activities and Pro-Inflammatory Cytokine Production
pmc-12566428.creator: Ruttiros Khonkarn, Krai Daowtak, Oranit Kraseasintra, Thitiya Luetragoon, Kanchana Usuwanthim, Kraisorn Taynawa, Kanokphon Chanphong, Jie Zhang, Tiehua Zhang, Zhengyi Wei
pmc-12566428.description: This study investigated the contamination, composition, and functional properties of Wolffia globosa from northern Thailand. The results showed that the heavy metal content of dried W. globosa complied with Thai regulations, ensuring its safety. Its proximate analysis revealed high protein levels with lysine, leucine, and phenylalanine as the principal essential amino acids.

pmc-12634844.title: Prevalence and associated factors of schistosomiasis among domestic ruminants in Ethiopia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12634844.creator: Yihenew Getahun Ambaw, Simachew Getaneh Endalamew, Ambachew Motbaynor Wubaye, Simegnew Adugna Kallu
pmc-12634844.description: Schistosomiasis is a significant concern for animal and public health, particularly in low-income and rural areas with limited access to clean water and healthcare services. Evidence on the national pooled prevalence and risk factors of ruminant schistosomiasis in Ethiopia is limited, underscoring the need for further research to inform effective control strategies.

pmc-12663703.title: Development of a Virtual Home-Based Cycling Intervention for Individuals With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: Qualitative Study
pmc-12663703.creator: Kristina Krogh Christensen, Henrik Bøggild, Ulla Møller Weinreich, Anna Lei Stoustrup
pmc-12663703.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a leading cause of mortality, and exercise has been shown to reduce both. Health conditions, environmental factors, and logistical challenges are often barriers for participation in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR). Given the barriers many individuals with COPD face when attending health care centers for PR, virtual home-based cycling exercise could be an option.

pmc-12740206.title: Extensive ischemic change on stroke presentation is uncommon: A population-based study
pmc-12740206.creator: Yasmin N Aziz, Achala Vagal, Heidi Sucharew, Brady J Williamson, Vivek Khandwala, Lily Wang, Rebecca Cornelius, Mary F Gaskill-Shipley, Thomas A Tomsick, David T Wang, Shantala Gangatirkar, Thomas Maloney, Paul S Horn, Mary Haverbusch, Janice A Carrozzella, David J Robinson, Robert J Stanton, Eva A
pmc-12740206.description: Background:Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) treatment and prognosis depend on the extent of ischemia sustained at time of presentation. The Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score (ASPECTS) is used for anterior circulation stroke triage and decision making. We sought to determine the distribution of baseline ASPECTS at a population level.

pmc-12786011.title: Comparative Thermal Tolerance and Tissue-Specific Responses Patterns to Gradual Heat Stress in Reciprocal Cross Hybrids of Acipenser baerii and A. schrenckii
pmc-12786011.creator: Wei Wang, Linan Gao, Xiaoyu Yan, Wenjie Liu, Tian Dong, Hailiang Song, Guoqing Ma, Hongxia Hu
pmc-12786011.description: The increasing frequency and intensity of heatwaves due to climate change pose significant challenges to sturgeon aquaculture. This study investigated the effects of gradual heat stress (1 °C every 8 h) on two reciprocal hybrid sturgeon strains (Acipenser baerii ♀ × A. schrenckii ♂, (BS hybrid); A. schrenckii ♀ × A.

pmc-13280789.title: Utility of prenatal trio whole-exome sequencing and methylation-specific multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification in the evaluation of fetal growth restriction
pmc-13280789.creator: Yangping Chen, Mianmian Wang, Xiaohe Cai, Xiuxiu Wu, Jiangzhong Zeng, Lili Zhou
pmc-13280789.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to explore the application value of prenatal trio whole-exome sequencing (trio-WES) and methylation-specific multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification (MS-MLPA) in fetal growth restriction (FGR).MethodsThe clinical data of 66 cases of FGR in fetuses who underwent interventional prenatal diagnosis at Wenzhou Central Hospital from January 2022 to July 2025 were retrospectively collected.

pmc-13385046.title: Comparative meta-analysis of task-related functional brain abnormalities in nonsuicidal self-injury and suicide attempt
pmc-13385046.creator: Lu Tang, Xiqin Liu, Yuanyuan Li, Nanfang Pan, Jianyu Li, Jian Zhou, Benjamin Becker, Qiyong Gong
pmc-13385046.description: BackgroundNonsuicidal self-injury (NSSI) and suicide attempt (SA) are two major self-injurious behaviors causing substantial suffering and socioeconomic burden. However, it remains unclear whether NSSI and SA are characterized by common or distinct brain dysregulations. Here, we aimed to identify shared and separable neurofunctional alterations during task engagement between NSSI and SA.

pmc-13407702.title: Green Recovery of Rosmarinic Acid via Whey Soy Protein-Mediated Foam Fractionation: Molecular Mechanisms and Enhanced Antioxidant Activity
pmc-13407702.creator: Yanfei Li, Run Yang, Hongjie Xiang, Zhirong Zhang, Zhijun Zhang, Nan Hu
pmc-13407702.description: The sustainable isolation of nonamphiphilic phytochemicals remains a formidable challenge in biochemical engineering. In this study, a highly efficient and solvent free foam fractionation process was developed for recovering rosmarinic acid from botanical extracts. By systematically screening diverse biological surfactants, whey soy protein emerged as an exceptionally robust dual functional frother and nanoscale collector.

pmc-13506517.title: Pulmonary amyloidosis, gastric MALT lymphoma, and multiple sclerosis in a patient with Sjögren’s disease: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-13506517.creator: Nikolaos Zintziovas, Georgios A. Drosos, Melina Yerolatsite, Anna Goussia, Vasiliki Kostadima, Anastasia K. Zikou, Paraskevi V. Voulgari
pmc-13506517.description: Sjögren’s disease (SjD) is a systemic autoimmune disorder associated with lymphocytic gland infiltration and an increased risk of B-cell lymphomas, particularly mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) lymphoma. Neurological involvement may mimic multiple sclerosis (MS), while true coexistence, especially with amyloidosis, is exceptionally rare. We performed a systematic review and present a representative clinical case.

pmc-13575230.title: High-entropy engineering of spinel catalysts for nonradical catalytic ozonation with improved resistance to humidity and sulfur poisoning
pmc-13575230.creator: Shulin Zuo, Muke Lin, Guizhi Xu, Jiahao Huang, Rumeng Zhang, Ji Mei, Jingyun Fang, Dehua Xia
pmc-13575230.description: Conventional catalytic ozonation of electron-rich sulfur-containing pollutants shows limited efficiency due to nonselective oxidation of hydroxyl radicals (•OH) and sulfate-induced deactivation of active metal sites. Here, we synthesized a high-entropy spinel, (CuNiMnCo)Fe2O4, featuring sublattice-resolved electronic reconstruction that enables selective ozone activation and suppresses sulfur poisoning. The catalyst achieves 99% removal of methyl mercaptan (CH3SH), significantly outperforming 51% of CoFe2O4.
